runtime_ui: Public streamed text, user messages, product interaction and necessary execution errors; technical tool cards and harness-loaded records no longer rendered.
developer_ui: Trace tab with tool calls, raw events, errors, source identity, model ledger and experiment references. Tools and RSI link to Trace. Existing Harness editor can be opened for a future candidate.
source_semantics: Exact raw trace bytes exported as base64 with SHA-256; snapshot ID binds the review payload.
Only newline-committed lines parsed; malformed records and incomplete tails explicitly retained and reported.
SQLite chat, model ledger, resolution and job records are read-only; file snapshots are separately observed and not claimed atomic with SQLite.
Stable tool-call IDs take priority. Legacy ordered-name single-candidate links remain labeled approximate; ambiguous links stay unresolved.
No inferred duration from receipt or ingest timestamps. No private reasoning added or requested.
rsi_boundary: Review data supports attribution and candidate proposals. Qualification, regression, future-task transfer and promotion remain separate; this feature adds no automatic optimizer, training labels or adoption.
limitations: Current export review limit 32 MiB per raw trace; larger source remains on disk.
Active logs may grow after a snapshot. Historical missing times/IDs remain unknown.
No full HTTP prompt reconstruction, automatic Harness RSI or hardware validation.
